_notes: plan (purchasable package) kept as အစီအစဉ် (already the product-wide term in marketing/common); the study-plan essay is distinguished as ပညာသင်အစီအစဉ်စာ and the personal roadmap as လမ်းပြမြေပုံ so the three never collide.
consultation unified to တိုင်ပင်ဆွေးနွေးမှု (the majority form in marketing); အကြံပေး ဆွေးနွေးမှု / plain ဆွေးနွေးမှု dropped.
tuition rendered as ကျောင်းလခ; ကျူရှင်ခ in Myanmar usage means private tutoring fees. Marketing/common still use ကျူရှင်ခ widely (owner decision: align there in a later pass).

Hangyul team → Hangyul အဖွဲ့, Hangyul Univ team → Hangyul Univ အဖွဲ့ exactly as the English; every remaining 'သင့်အတိုင်ပင်ခံ' (your counselor) in student-facing strings replaced, since the English no longer promises a personal counselor.

offer = ကမ်းလှမ်းချက်, admission offer = ဝင်ခွင့် ကမ်းလှမ်းချက်, admission letter = ဝင်ခွင့်စာ, standard admission letter = စံဝင်ခွင့်စာ (standard admission letter) with the English gloss once per screen.
consular legalization = ကောင်စစ်ဝန် အတည်ပြုချက်; apostille stays အပိုစတီးလ် (as in common/marketing).
sign up unified to အကောင့်ဖွင့် (စာရင်းသွင်း dropped); student task = လုပ်စရာ (agency task stays လုပ်ငန်းတာဝန်); upload = အပ်လုဒ်; document review = စစ်ဆေး (စိစစ် dropped).
Digits: the file mixes Myanmar and ASCII digits; normalized to ASCII to match placeholders and the majority of strings.
Localized placeholders (e.g. Hanoi National University → ရန်ကုန် တက္ကသိုလ်, Vietnamese → Myanmar companies) kept as market-appropriate examples.
mobile:login.networkError previously carried Android-emulator developer instructions; replaced with the English meaning.
